cases.title: Record Visited Link to Global History
cases.description: Verify that visiting a link correctly records the visit to the Global History.

cases.title: Record correct link after server redirect
cases.description: Verify that the correct link is recorded to the Global History after a server redirect occurs.

cases.title: Launch history link in browser window
cases.description: Verify that clicking on a history link causes it to be launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Delete single history entry
cases.description: Verify that a single History entry is successfully deleted upon performing the deletion action.

cases.title: Delete Multiple History Entries
cases.description: Verify that multiple history entries can be deleted and are no longer displayed.

cases.title: Clear Global History
cases.description: Verify that executing the clear Global History action successfully clears the entire Global History.

cases.title: Group history items by Day, Site, and None
cases.description: Verify that history items can be successfully grouped by Day, Site, or None.

cases.title: Sort History Column
cases.description: Verify that History is sorted per column.

cases.title: Reverse-Sort History Column
cases.description: Verify that History is reverse-sorted per column.

cases.title: Resize History Columns
cases.description: Verify that history columns are resizable to show or hide more of entries.

cases.title: Show History columns
cases.description: Verify that History columns are shown when selected.

cases.title: Hide History columns
cases.description: Verify that History columns are hidden when deselected.

cases.title: Re-visit recently visited sites via Back and Forward button dropdown menu
cases.description: Verify that recently visited sites can be re-visited by interacting with the Back and Forward button dropdown menu.

cases.title: New Browser Window Session History Creation
cases.description: Verify that a new, empty session history file is created when a new browser window is opened.

cases.title: Browser Restart Session History Creation
cases.description: Verify that a new, empty session history file is created upon a browser restart.

opinions.feedback: The test cases adequately cover the provided requirements without any blockers or missing scenarios.
All requirements and their corresponding test cases are well-structured, appropriately mapped, and fully testable. No blockers or redundant test cases found.

analysis.analysis: R-073: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal test scenario warranted. Trigger: Visited links. Outcome: Recorded to the Global History. R-074: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal test scenario warranted. Trigger: Server redirect occurs. Outcome: The correct link is recorded to the Global History. R-075: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal test scenario warranted. Trigger: Clicking on a history link. Outcome: Launched in a browser window. R-076: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal test scenario warranted. Trigger: History entry deletion action. Outcome: A History entry is deleted. R-077: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal test scenario warranted. Trigger: Multiple History entries deletion action. Outcome: Multiple History entries are deleted and no longer displayed. R-078: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal test scenario warranted. Trigger: Clear Global History action. Outcome: Global History is cleared. R-079: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal test scenario warranted. Trigger: History items grouping configuration. Outcome: History items are grouped by Day / Site / None. R-080: Multiple distinct behaviors. Normal test scenarios warranted. Behaviors: 1. Trigger: History column sort action. Outcome: History is sorted per column. 2. Trigger: History column reverse-sort action. Outcome: History is reverse-sorted per column. R-081: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal test scenario warranted. Trigger: History column resize action. Outcome: History columns are resizable to show/hide more of entries. R-082: Multiple distinct behaviors. Normal test scenarios warranted. Behaviors: 1. Trigger: History column show action. Outcome: History columns are shown. 2. Trigger: History column hide action. Outcome: History columns are hidden. R-083: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal test scenario warranted. Trigger: Interaction with Back and Forward button dropdown menu. Outcome: Recently visited sites are re-visited. R-084: Multiple distinct behaviors. Normal test scenarios warranted. Behaviors: 1. Trigger: New browser window creation. Outcome: A new, empty session history file is created. 2. Trigger: Browser restart. Outcome: A new, empty session history file is created.
